derived_claims.claim: Any degree-m polynomial p(A)v lies in K_(m+1)(A,v). Arnoldi-free recurrence differs algorithmically,not as a vector-space exclusion.
For B=QC+E,current H-dissipative J,positive-real shifts,rho<1,tail <= rho^(p+1)/(1-rho)*||R0Q||_(2->H)*||c_j||_2 + ||e_j||_H before arithmetic error.
Fresh directed current residual r_j=b_j-(I-gamma_j hJ)xhat_j gives ||error||_H<=||r_j||_H for positive-real shift; this includes compression and candidate arithmetic error.
T=R0-I=gamma0*h*R0J and z=(gamma-gamma0)/gamma0 normalize the same resolvent jet; no J-actions in recurrence, but residual J work remains and cancellation is not automatically eliminated.
Loop02 already proves complex inverse gain abs(gamma)/Re(gamma) for Re(gamma)>0 and H-dissipative J; missing piece is native directed complex application,not the theorem.
A Gershgorin row bound for symmetric-part dissipativity is sufficient only and may reject valid dissipative matrices.
Independent target/RHS evaluation can be parallel after shared recurrence; causal stage and recurrence-round dependencies remain.
